driver_archetypes.rationale: Standard compliant car with low impatience (0.0) to ensure red-light running is rare (target M3/share/car ~0.0076). Low jmDriveAfterRedTime ensures early_start rule doesn't trigger unnecessarily.
Compliant car subject to early-start rule to match M2/early/car share (0.0025). Increased jmDriveAfterRedTime allows the rule to trigger while maintaining compliance otherwise.
Standard motorcycle with 'right' alignment to match lateral position M4/lat_moto (~7m) and reduce overshoot depth. Slightly lower share (0.47) frees up space for swarm violators.
Slow motorcycle archetype for distribution 'moto' to trigger rule `slow_lane_center` and match lateral position/overshoot metrics.
Compliant motorcycle subject to early-start rule to match M2/early/moto share (0.1466). jmDriveAfterRedTime set to 2.0 allows triggering within the last few seconds.
Motorcycle subject to swarm_red_running rule to boost red-running share (M3/share/moto ~0.076). High impatience and moderate jm attributes make them prone to running red when swarmed.
Violating motorcycle from HMG/NT entering on red; high impatience and small minGap for queue dodging (rule `queue_space_seeking`) to match M8/moto wrong-lane share.
Illegal left-turner (HMG/NT) waiting in box; moderate impatience and release_lag rule to match M7a/n_waiting and reducing M7b/clear_lag delay.

traci_rules.rationale: Controls early start share for cars (~0.0025) and motorcycles (~0.1466). Lowered probability aligns with the rare car event while keeping moto high.
Models swarm pressure for motorcycles to match red-running share M3/share/moto (~0.076). Base probability p0 increased to boost total red-runners.
Triggers wrong-lane behavior (riding lane 0) for custom1 motorcycles to match M8/moto share (~0.2145). Full probability ensures the violation happens when conditions are met.
Adds release lag to box waiters for illegal left-turners matching M7a/n_waiting and reducing M7b/clear_lag delay.
Pushes slow motorcycles towards lane center/left to match M4/lat_moto (6.989m) and overshoot depth, but with a smaller offset to avoid excessive lateral drift.
Allows motorcycles to pass standing U-turners with high probability (M11) while cars stay behind. Increased probability encourages the observed squeezing behavior.

description: Spec targeting Hanoi intersection metrics by tuning driver patience, swarm aggression, and wrong-lane seeking probabilities to match observed red-running, early starts, and queue dodging behaviors.
